name: Shephatiah (son with Abital)
title: David's fifth son
summary: Shephatiah was the fifth son of King David, born to Abital in Hebron. He is mentioned in the genealogies of David's sons but plays no prominent role in biblical narratives beyond his place in the royal family.

keyEvents.title: Born in Hebron
keyEvents.description: Shephatiah was born as David's fifth son while David reigned as king in Hebron over Judah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in David's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Shephatiah is listed among David's sons in the genealogical records of Chronicles regarding the descendants of the royal house.
